label: Airport SIM counter: hours at Incheon Terminal 1 arrivals
appliesTo: Arrivals collecting or activating a SIM or eSIM at the airport
why: A red-eye arrival and a midday arrival are different decisions, and this is the figure that separates them. Counter hours are set by the carrier and change with terminal operations, so a guide that states them as permanent will be wrong before it is old.

history.source: KT — airport roaming centre locations and operating hours
history.note: KT operates roaming centres at Incheon Terminals 1 and 2, Gimpo and Gimhae, with round-the-clock cover at Incheon T1 arrivals. Other counters and other carriers keep their own hours — check the specific desk against your own landing time, not the airport in general.
